description: Defines the ThingSearchRoute class which creates Akka HTTP routes for '/search/things' endpoints, including count and search functionalities, with parameter parsing and route handling.

classes.name: ThingSearchRoute
classes.description: Creates HTTP routes for '/search/things' endpoints, handling count and search requests with parameter parsing.

methods.name: buildSearchRoute
methods.description: Constructs the '/search' route, delegating to count or search handlers based on path.

methods.name: countThings
methods.description: Handles '/search/things/count' requests, parsing parameters and invoking CountThings command.

methods.name: searchThings
methods.description: Handles '/search/things' requests, parsing parameters and invoking QueryThings command.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptional
methods.description: Initiates optional parameter parsing for search parameters.

methods.name: thingSearchParameterOptionalImpl
methods.description: Recursively processes search parameters, accumulating them into a map.

methods.name: calculateFilter
methods.description: Extracts filter string from optional parameter.

methods.name: calculateNamespaces
methods.description: Parses namespaces string into a set, or null if absent.

methods.name: calculateOptions
methods.description: Parses options string into a list, or null if absent.
